goal_template: Get help with <GOAL> — a need adjacent to this agent's purpose that it does not actually serve.
opening_intent: Asks confidently for the wrong thing, believing this is the right place for it.
followup_intents: pushes back once, assuming the agent simply misunderstood
asks who or where can actually help
asks whether anything at all can be done on this line
accepts redirection if it is concrete
success_criteria: the mismatch was recognized early and stated plainly
the caller left with a concrete pointer, not a dead end
quirks: mentions how they got this number
